texts.preamble: Vijay Kumar Kankariya vs Smt. Jyoti Bhanu on 1 February, 2023 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the complaint is time barred in view of Section 77 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. He submits that though in para 26 of the complaint, it has been mentioned that the Commissioner has extended the period up to two years for the prosecution, but in the entire complaint, no such letter has been annexed showing that the Commissioner has extended such period. He further submits that though the Designated Officer has moved an application for extension of period for the prosecution, but in the order dated 18.2.2021, there is no such mention that the period has been extended for 2 years.
